decisions.reason: The source identifies the sensor board's two connections from the main board and does not change the separate panel reset connector.
The candidate already specifies J_SENSOR_PWR as the main-to-sensor power connector with the stated type and pin count; the source introduces no change.
The source concerns connections entering the sensor board, not the main board's panel button and switch connectors.
The restriction applies to connections from the main board into the sensor board and does not remove or modify the separate PIR interface.
The source does not discuss or alter the independent capacitive-touch connectors and GPIO assignments.
Naming the sensor board's two main-board input connectors does not change the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The source concerns the sensor board's upstream connections and does not affect the separate LED array board.
The sensor board connector references do not change addressable-LED power, data drive, or level-shifting requirements.
The existing message-496 MODIFY already records J_SENSOR_SIG as the main-to-sensor signal connector reference, and no additional candidate attributes become obsolete or change.
The source does not discuss or alter the passive buzzer interface.
The source is consistent with the existing three-board architecture and sensor-board connector role but does not change either architectural requirement.
The source concerns sensor-board input connections and does not change the battery charge-status LED or connector design.
